name: Wheels Chatpata Masala Flavour
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour {Maida (53.5%)}, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein Oil), Starch (7.8%), Suga lodised Salt, Dehydrated Vegetable Powder (Onion Powder Garlic Powder, Tamarind Powder), *Spice & Condiments {Dry Mango Powder, Cumin Powder, Ginger Powder (0.35%), Chilli Powder (0.3%), Black Pepper Powder (0.05%)}, Acidity Regulator (INS 330, INS 296, INS 334) Colour (INS 160c), Flavour (Natural & Nature Identical Flavouring Substances) & Anti Caking Agent (INS 551) *Used as natural flavouring agent. Contains: Wheat May Contains Soy, Nut & Milk.
